correctness.rationale: For K_{a,b} with a,b≥2, W has w=b*C(a,2)+a*C(b,2) central generators and Vdim=a+b. Since E⊕W is abelian, rankKirillov≤2(a+b). A specific K2,3 mixed matrix has an integer unimodular (a+b)-minor; extending by vertices via one new two-path and a formerly unused edge column preserves determinant ±1, giving full row rank over every field for all nonexceptional bipartitions. For K2,2 the symbolic 4×4 mixed-block determinant is identically zero, giving rank≤6, and a rank-three D witness gives rank six. Hence index w+ab−a−b except K2,2 index w+2=6. Independently recomputed the special determinant in sympy and its rank-three witness; read the independent graph-bracket checker source and its unimodular minor construction. The all-fields assertion is supported by integer minors, not finite experiments.
